newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Rubber futures closed almost unchanged on Monday in moderate rade with players marking time in a mostly quiet market, dealers said.

"It's a really dead market. The exchange will be muddling along until the Chinese New Year next month and I doubt if the volume here will pick up much even after the holidays," a local rubber trader said.
Dealers said some buying for prompt shipments of RSS3 and RSS1 rubber were seen, but the volumes were probably light to moderate.
Another trader said: "It was utterly boring today. No one seemed to want to do anything. It was very quiet."
At around 0930 GMT, March RSS3 was seen at 123.00-125.00 U.S. cents a kg from last Friday's settlement of 123.50 cents.
March RSS1 was seen at 174.50-176.50 Singapore cents (US$1.24-$1.26) a kg from the previous 176.25 cents.
March TSR20 was seen at 168.50-170.50 Singapore cents (US$1.20-$1.22) a kg from the previous 170.00 cents.
